<!--

Partially fixes #97420

This PR ensures we always load the existing device registry, even if the (recently introduced) `configuration_url` isn't valid.

issue_context.title: Invalid configuration_url raise ValueError
issue_context.body:
### The problem

I wasn't able to update from 2023.8.0b0 to 2023.8.0b1, I got a rollback log with error " ValueError: invalid configuration_url 'http:///' "

As I checked in the device_registry I found that there was a "configuration_url": "http:///" line for my Netgear Orbi RBR50. Deleting the integration makes the update possible but now I'm unable to configure again Netgear (same issue, see below).

I think that the fact that this is now blocking the configuration is caused by the new check in the configuration_url from https://github.com/home-assistant/core/pull/97319

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2023.8.0b1

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

core-2023.8.0b0

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

Netgear

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/netgear/

### Diagnostics information

_No response_

### Example YAML snippet

_No response_

### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

```txt
Logger: homeassistant.config_entries
Source: helpers/device_registry.py:191
First occurred: 19:38:03 (2 occurrences)
Last logged: 19:41:48

Error setting up entry RBR350 - Orbi for netgear
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/config_entries.py", line 388, in async_setup
    result = await component.async_setup_entry(hass, self)
             ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/components/netgear/__init__.py", line 67, in async_setup_entry
    device_registry.async_get_or_create(
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/helpers/device_registry.py", line 567, in async_get_or_create
    device = self.async_update_device(
             ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/helpers/device_registry.py", line 708, in async_update_device
    new = attr.evolve(old, **new_values)
          ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.11/site-packages/attr/_funcs.py", line 366, in evolve
    return cls(**changes)
           ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "<attrs generated init homeassistant.helpers.device_registry.DeviceEntry>", line 8, in __init__
    _setattr('configuration_url', __attr_converter_configuration_url(configuration_url))
                                  ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/helpers/device_registry.py", line 191, in _validate_configuration_url
    raise ValueError(f"invalid configuration_url '{value}'")
ValueError: invalid configuration_url 'http:///'
```


### Additional information

_No response_
